name: Joseph Schlasberger
sources: Find a Grave, memorial 65818037 (Bartholomew Schriefer, Most Holy Redeemer Cemetery, Baltimore)
Ancestry.com, public member tree "Frank and Shugars Families" (tree 113007221), citing the Mistendorf parish registers and Baltimore church and civil records
notes: UNPROVEN: from the Find a Grave biographies and the "Frank and Shugars Families" member tree, which cites the Mistendorf parish registers; not yet checked against the registers. Named as the father of Bartholomew Schriefer (born 1839 at Zeegendorf); the son took his mother's surname, Schrüfer (Schriefer), which suggests his parents were not married when he was born. Spelled Schlasberger on Find a Grave and Schalsberger in the tree.
